Keep the 41 representatives structural-only, preserve prior evidence, and do not compute strategy returns, P&L, or economic outcomes. decision.research_action: Build an outcome-blind discovery-scope and power preflight. Select the candidate universe from the full EUR200-feasible authority using pre-outcome features; specify the estimand, dependence unit, missingness handling, and exploratory multiplicity approach before any strategy outcome is computed. Estimate power using effective independent reversal events, not raw M5 bars. Do not reuse an opened identity, outcome-exposed evidence, or the 41 structural representatives as the default discovery panel. Do not open an economic outcome or authorize trading.

universe_methodology.breadth_rule: Choose breadth from event independence, data completeness, structural heterogeneity, and pre-outcome power; do not impose a fixed panel size or select observed winners.

objective.goal: Prepare a prospective, mechanism-specific mean-reversion discovery scope and power design using the full eligible broker universe, without opening economic outcomes.
objective.information_gain_rationale: Mean reversion remains open despite exact-scope nulls and a low-power result. A full-feasible-universe, outcome-blind scope and effective-sample-size preflight can establish whether a materially broader development study is informative, while avoiding reuse of the 41-symbol topology panel as an inferential universe.
